name: OCR-VQA: Visual Question Answering by Reading Text in Images
description: OCR-VQA is a visual question answering benchmark focused on reading and comprehending embedded scene text in images, containing 1,002,141 question-answer instances across 207,572 book cover images spanning 34 genres.

license.name: Academic Research Use
license.notes: Released freely for academic research purposes on the official project website.

source_references.title: OCR-VQA: Visual Question Answering by Reading Text in Images

verification.notes: Verified against ICDAR 2019 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ICDAR.2019.00156) and official GitHub/portal releases. Comprises 1,002,141 question-answer pairs over 207,572 book cover images partitioned 80% train (801,712 QA pairs), 10% val (100,214 QA pairs), and 10% test (100,215 QA pairs).

size.notes: Book cover images and JSON question-answer annotations.
